packet.question: According to Microsoft's FY2024 10-K, who oversees cybersecurity risk and how often, and why are cyberthreats becoming harder to detect and defend against?

answer.answer: Microsoft delegates all cybersecurity oversight exclusively to its external auditor and the board has no role.

claims.text: Microsoft delegates all cybersecurity oversight exclusively to its external auditor and the board has no role.

optional_detail: Reviews may occur more often when necessary or advisable; at least quarterly already preserves the minimum cadence.

requirements.requirement: The Board of Directors oversees cybersecurity risk.
Board cybersecurity reviews are scheduled at least quarterly.
Constantly evolving, increasingly sophisticated and complex cyberthreats make detection and successful defense harder.
